page.title: Token Types
page.purpose: Let the minter declare the economies this instance runs, including the identity that gives each one its character.

priorities.statement: The supply policy of a type is understood before it is created, because it constrains everything afterwards.
Naming, symbol and color are presented as the branding surface they are.
priorities.notes: The product chrome stays neutral so the household's own economy is the thing with personality.

priorities.statement: Retiring a type is clearly distinct from deleting it; nothing here is ever deleted.

states.description: One or more token types declared.
No type exists; the page explains that nothing else in the product works until one does.
A type is being created or updated.
Supply policy or identity rejected, naming the constraint.
Types loaded but minted totals failed; each type renders with supply state marked unavailable.
Showing cached types after a failed refresh, labelled as such.

elements.name: Token types
elements.description: Each declared type with its supply policy and minted total.

elements.name: Identity
elements.description: Name, symbol and color for this economy.

elements.name: Retire
elements.description: Stops new issuance while preserving all history.

claims.statement: Each supply policy option carries an explanation of what it permanently constrains.
Retiring is offered and deleting is not; the copy states that history is preserved.
The empty state explains that no other surface functions until a type exists.
No field on this page accepts a price, currency, or monetary value of any kind.
claims.rationale: Structural expression of OT-P0-014: the constraint is enforced by the capability being absent.
